setup: CREATE TABLE c1_1_named_regex AS SELECT i, i::VARCHAR || '-alpha ' || (i + 1)::VARCHAR || '-beta' AS v, CASE i % 2 WHEN 0 THEN '([0-9]+)' ELSE '([0-9]+)-[a-z]+' END AS pattern FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: c1_1_regexp_extract_named_struct_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM struct_pack(number := i::VARCHAR, word := 'alpha') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM (SELECT i, regexp_extract(v, '([0-9]+)-([a-z]+)', ['number','word']) AS x FROM c1_1_named_regex) t

workloads.name: c1_1_regexp_extract_all_named_list_struct_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN x IS NOT DISTINCT FROM [struct_pack(number := i::VARCHAR, word := 'alpha'), struct_pack(number := (i + 1)::VARCHAR, word := 'beta')] THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM (SELECT i, regexp_extract_all(v, '([0-9]+)-([a-z]+)', ['number','word']) AS x FROM c1_1_named_regex) t

workloads.name: c1_1_group_by_all_dependency_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT i % 32, sum(i) FROM c1_1_named_regex GROUP BY ALL) t

workloads.name: c1_1_explicit_group_consumer_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT i % 32, sum(i) FROM c1_1_named_regex GROUP BY i % 32) t
